name: Smacient
description:
Smacient's Claude Connector for Marketers connects Claude directly to the platforms marketers actually work in - your own analytics and ad accounts, plus public competitive data across social, marketplace, and app-store platforms.

Query your own performance data directly from Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, Google Ads, and Meta Ads using your connected accounts. 

Surface competitive and market intelligence from platforms like Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube, along with local business and marketplace insights from Google Maps. Analyze app performance across Google Play and the App Store, and monitor competitor advertising through Google's and Meta's Ad Libraries.

Every tool is read-only. Nothing is ever posted, modified, or deleted on your behalf. Credit usage is shown after every call, and every tool exposes a `describe` action so Claude can look up exact parameters before running anything, keeping usage predictable and auditable.

Built for marketers, digital agencies, and marketing analysts who want Claude to pull real data instead of guessing - competitor benchmarks, keyword research, ad performance, review sentiment, and app rankings, all without leaving the conversation.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Smacient to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Smacient to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://claude.smacient.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Smacient MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Smacient provides these MCP tools: get-account-status, get-ad-libraries, get-app-intelligence, get-marketplace-intelligence, get-social-intelligence, query-ad-performance, query-keyword-insights, and query-web-performance.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Smacient?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Smacient in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Smacient requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Smacient is developed by Smacient. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
